Frontend.reason: Tracker now blocks explicit Words-plan generation while quota is loading, disabled or exhausted, while keeping manual planning available. Vocabulary Center shows an on-demand Words today summary with completed, target and remaining counts without polling. AI recommendation snapshots derive a 30-day target-attainment signal from paired Tracker target and actual counts, applying a conservative total-word ceiling only after at least three comparable executions. Settings now provides a compact homepage-personalization entry above AI Data Permissions. Its dialog keeps the title and metric overview fixed while users can independently show, hide and reorder eight feature cards; Dashboard renders only the resulting layout. The exam target area only edits the date, and countdown visibility is managed exclusively in this dialog.

Backend.reason: Reviewed the existing owner-scoped lexi_get_words_planning_context RPC and reused its non-persisted numeric projection for the progress card, so no table, migration, index or extra snapshot is added. The paired Lexi AI Edge Function accepts the new calibrated aggregate fields and maximumTotalWords bound while retaining backward compatibility with legacy Tracker snapshots. Homepage visibility and order remain device-local and require no schema, RPC, RLS or Edge Function change; hiding the Words summary prevents the existing summary RPC from being requested.

Admin.reason: Reviewed Lexi Control and its existing AI policy and quota controls. The new values are per-request derived aggregates, not persisted administrator-manageable state; the current words_plan_recommendation enable switch and daily quota remain sufficient. Homepage card visibility and order are individual device presentation choices, so no Control UI or admin RPC change is needed.

Deployment.reason: This is a local coordinated implementation and validation handoff. No production Supabase function or Cloudflare Pages deployment has been performed in this change.

Verification.reason: Tracker release verification passed impact review, typecheck, lint, 86 test files with 534 tests, production build and bundle safety checks. Targeted layout, backup, sync and Words-summary tests also passed. Browser validation confirmed the compact Settings entry, dedicated dialog, fixed-card labels, ordering, hiding, Dashboard mapping and default reset. The coordinated Words release gate had already passed after its latest code change; production smoke testing remains part of the later deployment step.
